title: Shadow fuzzbench for tool selection and argument schema validation
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build a production-attached 'shadow fuzzbench' that mirrors live function/toolcall traffic to a verification pipeline which runs candidate model/config variants, validates selected tool identity, and performs argument schema fuzzing + sanitizer checks. Purpose: detect regressions in tool selection accuracy and in argument structure/typing introduced by model changes or serving config flips before customer-visible impact.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow path receives >= 95% of sampled live eligible invocation events without adding latency to the primary path (copy only, async)
For a weekly sampled corpus (100k invocations), the harness computes per-deployment selection precision/recall and argument schema conformance rate and stores diffs in the eval-signal index
Automated alerts fire when selection_accuracy delta > 1.5% or argument_schema_conformance delta drops by >2% compared to baseline (configurable)
End-to-end pipeline PR merged and e2e test added that simulates drift scenarios (model variant + config toggle)
steps: Design shadow-copy transport (kafka topic with anonymization stage) and contract with serving runtime to emit lightweight invocation envelope
Implement verifier service that runs candidate model/config in a bounded sandbox (token/time budget) and compares tool id + args against golden reference
Integrate argument fuzzing harness: generate malformed/edge-case args and feed into schema validator + sanitizer module to measure robustness
Persist metrics to eval-metrics-store and expose dashboards/alerts via Console
Run a 2-week pilot on internal accounts and iterate thresholds before rolling to production
recent_activity: 2026-02-12: Spike complete. Validated low-latency shadow copy via Kafka mirror; added PII redaction library to transport (PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/53890)
2026-02-18: Prototype verifier implemented; initial test harness compares tool ids and returns diff events (internal run on sample corpus)
2026-02-24: Design review with product and security; flagged need for KMS-backed ephemeral keys when running candidate models in sandbox
2026-02-28: PR submitted for fuzz generator and schema validator (github.com/redwood/tooling/pull/2468); waiting on infra review
decisions: Run candidate models in a time-limited container with network egress disabled to prevent data exfiltration
Use production sampling of 0.2% of invocations initially to limit cost; adjustable via Console toggle
Baseline generation method: golden-run with currently-deployed model+config; compare each candidate against golden-run outputs for selection id and top-3 arg variants
metrics_baseline: Selection precision@1 baseline: 0.9735 (sampled week 2026-01-25 to 2026-01-31); argument schema conformance baseline: 99.2%
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (pilot): internal org only, 0.2% sample, 2 weeks
Phase 2 (canary): 5% sample for 1 week on non-critical accounts
Phase 3 (production): 20% sample and set alerting thresholds; enable auto-checks on pre-deploy for config flips
